text: 爱尔兰新设的零售储蓄与投资账户将享有5万欧元的免税额度，超过该额度的账户余额按1%的统一税率征税。爱尔兰投资账户每年最高缴款上限为1.2万欧元，无最低缴款要求，并允许投资股票、债券、ETF及其他基金。该账户不征收资本利得税，也不适用“视同处置”规则；财政部长西蒙·哈里斯表示，这是投资计划的第一阶段，他愿意重新审视缴款上限。
text_en: Ireland's newly created retail savings and investment account will enjoy a tax-free allowance of 50,000 euros, with balances above that threshold taxed at a flat rate of 1%. The Irish investment account will have an annual maximum contribution cap of 12,000 euros, with no minimum contribution requirement, and will allow investment in stocks, bonds, ETFs and other funds. The account will not be subject to capital gains tax, nor will deemed disposal rules apply; Finance Minister Simon Harris said this is the first phase of the investment plan and that he is willing to revisit the contribution cap.
